introH2: ✈️ Staying Near Don Mueang Airport — What You Actually Need to Know
introHtml: Don Mueang Airport (DMK) is Thailand's primary low-cost carrier hub — AirAsia, Nok Air, Lion Air and VietJet all depart from here. That means a large share of travellers face the same problem: a 5am departure and a decision about where to sleep the night before. The hotels ringing DMK range widely — from a 4-star property with a second-floor skywalk straight into Terminal 1 to a bare-bones budget room just 800m from the runway. Two questions come up every time: How far away? And is there a free shuttle? This roundup answers both for all 7 hotels we've reviewed in depth, plus honest notes on what each property does well and where it falls short. Prices are compared across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com — click any booking link to see today's rate.
mrtHtml: Don Mueang Airport is in the Donmueang district along Viphavadi Rangsit Road in northern Bangkok. There is no BTS or MRT running to the terminals directly, but the SRT Red Line stops at Don Mueang station roughly 1km from the terminal building — it links to Bang Sue Grand Station (Krung Thep Aphiwat). From central Bangkok by expressway expect 25–40 minutes depending on traffic. The 7 hotels in this guide are within a 1–6 km radius of the airport. Some offer free transfers; some charge a small fee; one has no shuttle at all — we spell it out clearly under every entry. If you need to return from the airport independently, Grab and metered taxis are available outside the arrivals hall 24 hours a day, typically THB 60–150 to destinations within Donmueang district.

entries.name: Amari Don Muang Airport Bangkok
entries.badge: ✈️ Skywalk to Terminal 1 in 7 minutes — no waiting for a shuttle
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Skywalk (Level 2) directly to Terminal 1 DMK — approx. 450m, 7-min walk. No transfer needed.
entries.addr: 333 Moo 10 Chert Wudthakas Road, Si Kan, Don Mueang, Bangkok
entries.storyHtml: Amari Don Muang Airport Bangkok earns the top spot on one decisive advantage: a covered second-floor skywalk connects the hotel directly to Gates 5–6 of Terminal 1 in about 450 metres and 7 minutes of walking — the only hotel in this guide where you can roll your luggage to the check-in counter without ever calling for a transfer. A saltwater outdoor pool, breakfast buffet, 7-day complimentary parking (direct booking) and a score of 8.8 across 2,600+ reviews add up to a strong all-round package. One caveat worth knowing: the property is mid-renovation (May 2025–September 2026), so un-renovated rooms are starting to show their age, and check-in queues on busy travel days can run longer than expected.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Mention the renovation when booking and ask for a recently refurbished room. The skywalk entrance is on Level 2 of the hotel — during construction phases the route may be briefly diverted, so pick up a floor plan at the front desk before heading out.
pros: Skywalk 450m / 7 minutes straight into DMK Terminal 1 — no shuttle wait, day or night
Saltwater pool, breakfast buffet, 7-day free parking with direct booking
Only 4-star hotel in this guide; consistent 8.8 score from 2,600+ reviews
cons: Mid-renovation (May 2025–Sep 2026) — un-renovated rooms show wear; ask for a newer wing
Check-in queues can stretch past 60 minutes on public holidays and peak-season weekends
Priciest in this guide, starting at THB 1,960 — worth it if the skywalk connection is the deciding factor

entries.type: 3-Star Hotel · Highest Score · Most Reviews in This Guide
entries.name: 12 The Residence Hotel & Apartment
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.1 · Agoda 9.1 · 4,003 reviews (most in this guide)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Don Mueang district, ~4km from DMK. Free one-way shuttle to airport every hour from 4am, approx. 8 min. Return trip: take Grab or Red Line train.
entries.addr: 22 Soi Sornkhom 10, Si Kan, Don Mueang, Bangkok 10210
entries.storyHtml: 12 The Residence Hotel & Apartment sits second on the strength of its numbers alone — a 9.1 score across 4,003 reviews on Trip.com is the highest and most verified in this entire guide. The 156-room property opened in 2022, sits about 4km from DMK, and runs a free airport shuttle every hour starting at 4am (roughly 8 minutes to the terminal). A Japanese-American breakfast buffet, gym and fast Wi-Fi round out the package for a solid mid-range price. Critical caveats before you book: the free shuttle runs one way only (hotel to airport), seats are limited to 9 per run and must be reserved with reception — do not leave this until the morning of departure. There is also a THB 1,000 cash deposit collected at check-in, and some guests report noisy air-conditioning units.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Reserve your shuttle seat the moment you check in — 9 seats per run fills fast on busy travel days. Have THB 1,000 in cash ready for the deposit. If light sleep is important, request a room away from the corridor.
pros: Score 9.1 from 4,003 verified reviews — highest and most reviewed in this guide
Free hourly shuttle to DMK from 4am, reaches the terminal in about 8 minutes
Spacious rooms, Japanese-American breakfast buffet, gym included
cons: Shuttle is departure only — no return pickup; must be booked in advance, only 9 seats per run
THB 1,000 cash deposit required at check-in (refunded on departure)
Some rooms have noisy air-conditioning units or hallway noise (per guest reviews)

entries.type: Budget 2-Star Hotel · Closest Non-Skywalk Hotel to DMK
entries.name: Don Muang Hotel
entries.badge: 📍 ~800m from DMK — closest budget option in this guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 ~800m from DMK Terminal 1. Paid shuttle THB 35–40/person, runs 04:00–09:30 to airport and 22:00–03:00 from airport. Or walk over Song Prapha bridge (~10–15 min).
tags: 📍 ~800m from DMK — walk or short ride
entries.addr: 5 Soi Saranahkome 3, Si Kan, Don Mueang, Bangkok 10210
entries.storyHtml: Don Muang Hotel lands at number three on proximity alone — at roughly 800 metres from DMK it is the closest budget option in this guide after the Amari. You can walk across Song Prapha bridge in 10–15 minutes with your luggage, or take the hotel's paid shuttle (THB 35–40 per person) which departs from 4am. The kitchen opens at 4am too, making this the most practical option for passengers on early morning departures who want to eat a proper breakfast before their flight. With 3,325 reviews, there is a clear consensus: you get a clean, no-frills room at the lowest price in the area. The cons are real though — thin walls let in neighbour noise, the oldest buildings have no lift, and the standard rooms are basic.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify a lift-equipped building when booking. Book the shuttle with reception the night before — it departs on schedule from 4am. Pack earplugs if you sleep lightly.
pros: ~800m from DMK Terminal 1 — walk the Song Prapha bridge or take the THB 35–40 shuttle from 4am
Lowest price in this guide from THB 550; breakfast opens at 4am for ultra-early flights
3,325 reviews confirm clean, reliable basics; free parking available
cons: Budget 2-star: thin walls, neighbour noise audible in many rooms
Older wings have no lift — bring a light bag or request a ground-floor room
No pool, limited restaurant options; shuttle is paid, not free (THB 35–40/person)

entries.name: Best Western Nada Don Mueang Airport Hotel
entries.badge: 🏨 Score 9.0 · Best Western brand · BTS station 300m walk
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phahonyothin Road, Bang Khen · ~5km from DMK · Free shuttle (must pre-book, starts 5am) ~15 min · BTS Phahonyothin 59 station ~300m walk
entries.addr: 235/8 Phahonyothin Road, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220
entries.storyHtml: Best Western Nada Don Mueang Airport Hotel earns fourth place on a strong score (9.0 from 1,438 reviews) and a unique advantage not found elsewhere in this guide: BTS Phahonyothin 59 is just 300m away on foot, giving you a credible alternative to the airport shuttle if timing or capacity is an issue. Multiple guests describe getting 4-star service at a 3-star price. The free shuttle starts at 5am and covers the roughly 5km to DMK in 15 minutes — but it must be pre-booked and holds only 9 passengers per run. Street-facing rooms pick up BTS train noise from early morning to late evening, and there is no pool.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pre-book your airport shuttle with the hotel before arriving — 9 seats fills fast. Request an interior or courtyard-facing room to avoid BTS noise.
pros: Score 9.0 from 1,438 reviews; Best Western service standards at a 3-star price
Free shuttle to DMK from 5am (~15 min); BTS Phahonyothin 59 just 300m on foot
Nada Cuisine breakfast buffet praised in reviews; free parking
cons: Farthest from DMK at ~5km; shuttle must be pre-booked, 9 seats only

entries.storyHtml: The Prima Residence is a 37-room SHA Plus property that focuses on exactly what pre-flight guests need — it is 2km from DMK with a free shuttle running from 4am (reaching the terminal in about 6 minutes), set on a quiet soi that insulates you from road noise, and every room is noticeably larger than the price suggests (25–32 sqm with a private balcony, fridge and microwave). Guests consistently highlight the calm atmosphere and the roominess as the main reasons to return. The catch: the free shuttle operates mornings only (04:00–09:30). For afternoon or evening flights you will need a taxi at about THB 60. Some reviews also mention mosquitoes in rainy season, particularly on lower floors.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Mention your departure time to reception at check-in and nail down a shuttle slot — it is the most-requested thing at this property. Ask for a higher-floor room to minimize mosquito exposure during the wet season.
pros: ~2km from DMK; free shuttle from 4am reaches the terminal in ~6 minutes

entries.storyHtml: SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang is the cheapest 3-star option in this guide at THB 650/night, and it earns its place as a serviceable overnight stop — there is an in-house restaurant, breakfast service, free parking and a lively street-food strip on Song Prapha road nearby. It sits about 6km from DMK, which means a taxi at roughly THB 59 and 12 minutes of travel. The important point to be clear about before booking: there is no hotel shuttle. Real guest reviews across multiple platforms also note fairly firm beds, thin walls that carry neighbour noise, and inconsistent cleanliness standards from room to room — not a dealbreaker at this price, but worth knowing.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Taxis are available outside the hotel 24 hours — budget THB 59–80 to reach DMK. Request an upper-floor room away from adjacent rooms if noise is a concern. Earplugs are useful here.

Good location for the price — Song Prapha street food, convenience stores within walking distance
Score 8.4 on Trip.com; friendly staff

entries.storyHtml: Room Quest Don Mueang Airport ranks last because its 6.8 score from 213 reviews is the lowest in this guide, but there is still a clear use case for it — 3km from DMK with an on-site shuttle (confirm schedule and any fee directly with the property), every room comes with a private balcony, fridge and free Wi-Fi, there is free parking, and the coworking lobby is a practical bonus if you have layover hours to fill. Guest reviews flag ageing room fittings, road noise and an occasionally confusing self check-in process as the consistent downsides. If your only goal is the cheapest possible bed near the airport for one night, it serves that purpose.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm the shuttle schedule and any charge before arrival — contact the property directly. Have your passport or national ID ready for the self check-in kiosk. Notify the hotel if your flight departs before 6am.

Every room has a private balcony, fridge and free Wi-Fi

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Staying Near Don Mueang Airport

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best hotel near Don Mueang Airport Bangkok?
faq.a: It depends on your priority. For the closest possible walk to Terminal 1 without waiting for a transfer, Amari Don Muang Airport has a second-floor skywalk that puts you at the terminal in 7 minutes. For the best combination of guest score and review volume in a mid-range price bracket, 12 The Residence Hotel scores 9.1 from 4,003 verified reviews and runs a free shuttle every hour from 4am. For the cheapest option closest to the runway, Don Muang Hotel starts at THB 550 and is just 800m from DMK.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotels near Don Mueang Airport offer a free airport shuttle?
faq.a: Three hotels in this guide offer free shuttles: Amari Don Muang Airport (skywalk access plus a free shuttle service), 12 The Residence (free hourly departure-only shuttle from 4am — pre-booking required, 9 seats per run) and The Prima Residence (free shuttle 04:00–09:30 mornings only). Best Western Nada also offers a free shuttle but requires advance booking and has 9 seats only. Don Muang Hotel charges THB 35–40 per person. SweetLoft has no shuttle at all.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get from Don Mueang Airport into central Bangkok?
faq.a: The SRT Red Line departs from Don Mueang station (about 1km from the terminal building, connected by a free shuttle bus) and links to Krung Thep Aphiwat (Bang Sue Grand Station), where you can connect onward. A metered taxi from the arrivals hall to central Bangkok typically costs THB 150–250 depending on destination and traffic. Grab is easy to book from the arrivals area. Several hotels in this guide — Amari, 12 The Residence and The Prima Residence — run shuttles to and/or from the airport; always confirm times and any fees directly with your hotel.

faq.q: ❓ What is the closest hotel to Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: The closest hotel in this guide is Amari Don Muang Airport, connected to Terminal 1 by a covered Level-2 skywalk (450m, 7 minutes). After that, Don Muang Hotel is roughly 800m away — walkable over Song Prapha bridge in 10–15 minutes, or a short paid shuttle ride (THB 35–40). The Prima Residence is about 2km away with a free morning shuttle.

faq.q: ❓ How much should I budget for a hotel near Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: In this guide, starting prices range from THB 550 to THB 1,960 per night. Budget options (Don Muang Hotel, Room Quest) start at THB 550. Mid-range 3-star properties (SweetLoft, 12 The Residence, The Prima Residence) range from THB 650–1,100 for standard rooms. Best Western Nada starts at THB 1,200. Amari, the only 4-star in this guide, starts at THB 1,960. High season (November–February) and Thai public holidays push all prices higher.

faq.q: ❓ How far in advance should I book a Don Mueang Airport hotel?
faq.a: Several properties here are small: The Prima Residence has 37 rooms and Room Quest has just 24. During high season (November–February) and Thai long weekends, book at least one to two weeks ahead. Amari is larger but fills fast because it is the only skywalk-connected hotel at DMK — lock in a free-cancellation rate as soon as your flights are confirmed if you want flexibility.
